sloka: स तत्र कांच्चित् परिषस्वजे नरान्नराश्च केचित्तु तमभ्यवादयन् ।चकार सर्वान् सवयस्य बान्धवान् यथार्हमासाद्य तदा नृपात्मज: ॥ २.१०२.४८॥
transliteration: sa tatra kāṁccit pariṣasvaje narānnarāśca kecittu tamabhyavādayan ।cakāra sarvān savayasya bāndhavān yathārhamāsādya tadā nṛpātmaja: ॥ 2.102.48॥

translations.english: Rama embraced some, while others paid him obeisance. Therafter, he honoured his erstwhile companions and relations in accordance with their status.
